decisions.reason: The teaching-moment modification does not change the clean-editing requirement; the separate editing-style clauses in the same message are already represented by its existing same-message Events.
The teaching-moment modification does not alter caption styling, and the message's independent caption requirements are already captured by an existing same-message MODIFY.
Requiring complete lessons or stories clarifies clip content quality but does not change the three-clip qualification method, count, deadline, or success condition.
The complete-teaching-moment standard does not change the permitted source content or the requirement that all three trial clips come from one YouTube video.
Completeness and standalone teaching value are distinct from whether a source moment is strong or impactful; the existing moment-selection standard remains valid unchanged.
The source decision adds content-completeness criteria but does not change the established 30-to-90-second duration range.
The trial clips' teaching and standalone-content standard does not change the deferred Lead Clipper pathway, training focus, compensation, or responsibilities.
The content-quality modification does not alter the project-chat submission channel or the type of material submitted for review.
The complete-teaching-moment standard does not change the requirement to produce 125 approved clips per month.
